title: Coral and the Horizon
author: Yara Eastwick
blurb: Jude Hartwell, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, has spent seven years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
